answer: Identity registers against a bond of 60 units plus one attested hardware credential per device, and every registration event is hashed into an ember log that anchors each key. Forging N identities locks 60N units for 45 epochs, with 100% slashing triggered on any duplicate credential. Splitting one bond across many keys lowers the sybil nadir to nothing, since jurors flag shared funding trails and one pearl of a penalty hits all linked keys.
